verbatim_source_excerpt: **XOM — 유가 수혜 강세 관찰하되 급등 추격 보류(positive_watch).**
thesis: Oct 30 Q3 official GAAP earnings $15.4bn vs Q2 $14.5bn, adjusted earnings $17.5bn, operating cashflow $25.7bn and FCF $19.1bn. Oct 30 stock +2.16% to $187.25, approaching 52-week high; strong cash conversion but oil/refining exposure.
counterevidence: Crude prices and refining margins could normalize sharply; strong recent stock return and higher valuation limit upside. XLE provides overlapping energy exposure.
invalidation: Material decline in refining margins or free cash flow, verified oil supply normalization, or sustained relative weakness vs SPY.
entry_trigger: No chase. Reassess only after consolidation and verified hold of Oct 30 low $184.68 or a confirmed breakout above $188.50 with volume, spread and positive relative strength.
trigger_validity: 1-5 NYSE sessions for post-earnings consolidation; 2-6 weeks and months for cashflow and oil sensitivity.
target_and_stop_basis: Oct 30 low $184.68 and high $188.50 are observed anchors; ATR/volatility and oil gap-risk validation required for stop, first target and post-cost R:R.
